parsed.name: Tektronix TDS224 数字示波器
parsed.description: 一款多通道数字示波器，模拟带宽为 100 MHz，用于测量和采集电信号波形，并可从通道、参考波形或数学波形源读取波形数据。
parsed.description_en: A multi-channel digital oscilloscope with 100 MHz analog bandwidth, used to measure and acquire electrical waveforms and to read waveform data from channel, reference, or math sources.
